escalation.rationale: Score holds near peak as Trump formally rejects Iran's Hormuz peace plan sending Brent above $107, a foiled Iran-linked bombing plot near RAF Fairford raises alliance threat levels, and Russia continues mass drone bombardment of Ukrainian civilian areas including Kyiv and Kharkiv.

ticker_items: Trump rejects Iran's Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal; Brent crude tops $107.
Five men arrested near RAF Fairford in suspected Iran-linked bomb plot.
Russia drone strikes kill 2, wound dozens in Kyiv and Kharkiv regions.
South Korea demands apology from Ukraine over revealed North Korean POW transfer.
Saudi Arabia receives French military support as Houthi attacks on Yanbu escalate.

new_entrant.text: France is deploying military assets to protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil terminal as Houthi attacks mount, marking an expanded direct French military role in the Yemen-Saudi conflict.

eastern_europe.description: Russian overnight drone and missile strikes hit the Kyiv region, killing at least one person including an Azerbaijani citizen and wounding multiple civilians.
Russian strikes on Kharkiv wounded 10 children and multiple other civilians in overnight bombardment.
Round-the-clock Russian bombardment of civilian targets across Ukraine killed at least 3 and wounded 41 from Sunday to Monday.

middle_east.description: Houthi forces conducted significant strikes deep into Saudi territory including the strategically vital Yanbu oil terminal area, prompting French military deployment.
Saudi Air Force conducted strikes on a Taiz market, with the Houthi-run health ministry claiming civilian casualties and vowing retaliation.

observers.description: France is deploying military forces to protect Saudi Arabia's key Yanbu oil terminal amid escalating Houthi attacks. This marks a significant direct French military commitment to the Saudi theater and expands NATO-member involvement in the Gulf conflict.

Pakistan is holding military talks with Saudi Arabia regarding Houthi threat response and has offered diplomatic engagement. PM Sharif used his UNGA address to position Pakistan as a regional mediator while condemning multiple belligerents.

Turkiye is holding military consultations with Saudi Arabia alongside Pakistan as Houthi pressure mounts. Ankara continues to walk a fine line between Western alliance obligations and independent regional engagement.

Two North Korean prisoners of war captured fighting for Russia in Ukraine have been transferred to South Korea, confirmed by President Zelenskyy at the UN. The revelation caused a diplomatic rift between Kyiv and Seoul over a breached confidentiality agreement.

Seoul has demanded an official apology from Ukraine after Zelenskyy publicly disclosed the secret transfer of two North Korean POWs. South Korea is closely monitoring North Korean military involvement in the Russia-Ukraine war while managing the diplomatic fallout.

The UAE has suspended Iranian airline flights in compliance with US sanctions targeting Iranian civil aviation. This positions the UAE as aligned with US economic pressure on Tehran without direct military involvement.

Azerbaijan has suspended Iranian flights in compliance with US sanctions, and an Azerbaijani citizen was among those killed in the latest Russian strikes on Ukraine. Baku navigates delicate relationships with both Moscow and the Western-aligned sanctions regime.

Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz as part of diplomatic negotiations but the US formally rejected the plan, causing Brent crude to surge above $107. Tehran-linked operatives were arrested near RAF Fairford in the UK in a suspected bomb plot, significantly escalating Iran's campaign against countries backing US military action.

financial.notes: Brent crude surged more than 3% to top $107 per barrel after Trump formally rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, stoking fears of prolonged disruption to Gulf energy exports.

update_log.text: Trump rejects Iran's Strait of Hormuz reopening plan; Brent crude surges above $107 per barrel.
Five men arrested near RAF Fairford, UK, suspected of Iran-linked bomb plot targeting US air base.
RFE/RL confirms Russian overnight strikes on Kyiv and Kharkiv kill 2 (including Azerbaijani national) and injure dozens, among them 10 children.
South Korea demands formal apology from Ukraine after Zelenskyy publicly reveals secret North Korean POW transfer to Seoul.
France confirms military deployment to protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil terminal as Houthi attacks intensify.
Iran insists on diplomatic solution after US ambassador Waltz labels Tehran's Hormuz proposal an 'unacceptable cynical attempt.'
UAE and Azerbaijan suspend Iranian airline flights in compliance with US civil aviation sanctions campaign.
Houthi forces report Saudi airstrikes on Taiz market; Saudi Air Force does not confirm, claims cannot be independently verified.
ISW-cited reporting indicates Ukrainian forces have successfully contested Russian initiative since late 2025; Russian MoD accused of exaggerating advances.
